description:
Tanganga is a small fishing village located on the Pacific coast of Colombia unlike any place I’ve ever been. It has sweeping mountain vistas of bluish gray rocks, white sand, beaches, and crystal clear water.

This morning, I sat out with Jefferson and Ricardo, two local fisherman who go out daily to catch their own food and sell anything extra to the market. They are NOT charter captains- they are subsistence fisherman who use hand lines and harpoons.

After six hours on the water, my friend Sebastian and I had bagged six fish, and I had a newfound respect for these humble hard-working men 🇨🇴🎣❤️ #joefelz #travel #experience #colombia #fishing #culture #traditional #saltlife #spearfishing #ocean #subsistence #fisherman #goodtimes
